en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from Muhammad Bin Isa, from Yunus Bin Abdul Rahman, from Hafs Bin Qurt, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘The one who claims that Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Commands with the evil and the immoralities, so he has lied upon Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, and the one who claims that the good and the evil exist without the Desire of Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, so he has exited Allah<sup>azwj</sup> from His<sup>azwj</sup> Authority, and the one who claims that the disobedience is (committed) without the (given) Strength of Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, so he has lied upon Allah<sup>azwj</sup>. And the one who lies upon Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, Allah<sup>azwj</sup> would Enter him into the Fire’.
